inputs.style: Joyful instrumental game victory celebration, 104 BPM, D major. Bright orchestral brass, nimble string runs, celesta, marimba, cymbal swells and cheerful hand percussion. Rewarding and warm, a small earned celebration after defending a planet. Short melodic phrases with a clear resolved ending. Original video game instrumental score. Only musical instruments. No vocals, no singing, no speech, no choir, no humming, no vocal samples. Clear melodic phrases, restrained dynamics, spacious clean production, gentle high frequencies, controlled bass, seamless flowing arrangement.
inputs.lyrics:
[Instrumental fanfare: rising brass and sparkling celesta]
[Instrumental celebration: strings and marimba answer the fanfare]
[Instrumental ending: a bright major chord and ringing bells]
